    Summarize per-forecast scores

    Source: R/score_model_out.R
    summarize_model_out_scores.Rd

    Summarizes scores computed by score_model_out() with summarize = FALSE. The result is the same as calling score_model_out() with summarize = TRUE on the forecasts those scores came from, but the forecasts only need to be scored once. This is useful when the same scores are summarized several ways, for example by different by columns or over different subsets of the forecasts.

    Usage

    summarize_model_out_scores(
  scores,
  relative_metrics = NULL,
  baseline = NULL,
  by = "model_id",
  include_count = FALSE
)

    Arguments

    scores

    Per-forecast scores, as returned by score_model_out(summarize = FALSE), or a subset of their rows.

    relative_metrics

    Character vector of scoring metrics for which to compute relative skill scores. Each must be one of the metrics in scores, and relative skill requires that "model_id" is included in by. See score_model_out() for which metrics are supported and how comparison groups are formed. If NULL (the default), no relative metrics are computed.

    baseline

    String with the name of a model to use as a baseline for relative skill scores. If a baseline is given, then a scaled relative skill with respect to the baseline will be returned. By default (NULL), relative skill will not be scaled with respect to a baseline model. If the baseline is absent from a comparison group, that group's relative and scaled relative skill are reported as NA (with a warning) while its absolute scores are still returned. This NA case only arises when scoring is disaggregated: with by = "model_id" alone there is a single comparison group containing every model, so relative skill is always defined and is never NA. A baseline absent from the data entirely is an error.

    by

    Character vector naming columns to summarize by. For example, specifying by = "model_id" (the default) will compute average scores for each model.

    include_count

    Boolean indicator of whether to add a column count giving the number of forecasts scored in each summary group. Defaults to FALSE.

    Value

    A tibble of summarized scores, in the same form as score_model_out() returns with summarize = TRUE.

    Details

    If the scores were computed with transform_append = TRUE and a transform, average scores are reported separately for the natural and transformed scales (the scale column), as in score_model_out().

    Relative skill is computed within each group of the by columns other than "model_id", using the forecasts in scores. Summarizing a subset of the scored forecasts therefore gives the same relative skill as scoring only that subset.

    Scores that have already been summarized can't be summarized again, since averaging group means gives the wrong result when groups have different numbers of forecasts.

    Examples

    model_out_tbl <- hubExamples::forecast_outputs |>
  dplyr::filter(.data[["output_type"]] == "quantile")
oracle_output <- hubExamples::forecast_oracle_output

# score once
row_scores <- score_model_out(
  model_out_tbl,
  oracle_output,
  metrics = c("wis", "interval_coverage_90"),
  summarize = FALSE
)

# summarize two ways without scoring again
summarize_model_out_scores(row_scores, relative_metrics = "wis")
#> # A tibble: 3 × 4
#>   model_id            wis interval_coverage_90 wis_relative_skill
#>   <chr>             <dbl>                <dbl>              <dbl>
#> 1 Flusight-baseline  329.                0.125              1.15 
#> 2 MOBS-GLEAM_FLUH    315.                0.562              1.10 
#> 3 PSI-DICE           228.                0.5                0.794
summarize_model_out_scores(
  row_scores,
  relative_metrics = "wis",
  by = c("model_id", "location")
)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 5
#>   model_id          location   wis interval_coverage_90 wis_relative_skill
#>   <chr>             <chr>    <dbl>                <dbl>              <dbl>
#> 1 Flusight-baseline 25        180.                0.25               1.13 
#> 2 Flusight-baseline 48        479.                0                  1.16 
#> 3 MOBS-GLEAM_FLUH   25        163.                0.5                1.02 
#> 4 MOBS-GLEAM_FLUH   48        468.                0.625              1.13 
#> 5 PSI-DICE          25        139.                0.625              0.872
#> 6 PSI-DICE          48        317.                0.375              0.765
